method: Human-visible image inspection after native rendering (downscaled contact sheets and the section figure). Hashes pin the reviewed images.
observations: The assembled case, front controls and LEDs are preserved.
Rear view and closeup show eleven open entrances with audio nuts and washers outside the plate.
All four DINs show the corrected contact pattern; MIDI OUT, THRU, MIDI IN and SYNC legends are readable at their retained positions.
Exploded view retains both boards, the original case and panels and PCB-mounted controls.
Control-side view keeps caps hidden; the wiring study keeps its 24 conductors attached to the moved I/O endpoints.
The 0.508 mm board move is not resolvable at these render scales; rear-datum-sections.png shows it in measured sections.
limitations: Image inspection supplements the geometric audits; it does not measure clearance.
POWER/USB lower-edge overlap remains as documented.
Images do not qualify physical assembly fit.
